You said:
pip install fails on Ubuntu 24.04 with error: externally-managed-environment
ChatGPT said:
Thinking…

This error comes from PEP 668: Ubuntu marks the system Python as managed by apt.

  1. Install the venv module:

    bash
    sudo apt install python3-venv

  2. Create and activate a virtual environment.

  3. Install your package with pip install requests.

bash
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate

Avoid --break-system-packages unless you know what you are doing.

You said:
How do I read a UTF-8 file on Windows without UnicodeDecodeError?
ChatGPT said:

Pass the encoding explicitly:

python
with open("data.txt", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    text = f.read()
  • Windows defaults to cp1252.
  • Alternatively set PYTHONUTF8=1.
